## Context
The documentation survey on `minimum-rainy-fawn` and session log `homemade-coltish-donkey` identified seven approved repository recommendations. The operator approved F08A, F08B, F09, F10, F12, F13, and all three F19 units. The operator then added F20 to correct the GitHub About description. Rejected F02, F03, and F04 remain excluded. Deferred F05 remains undecided.

## Plan
- Correct bounded README workflow and installation facts.
- Align operation-certificate and import guidance with current implementations and accepted ADRs.
- Complete ADR 0100 command discovery through the existing route registry.
- Repair MCP summary generation and transition registrar wording.
- Correct the generated configuration contract through three bounded F19 children.
- Update GitHub About metadata to lead with enforceable plan review and signed completion verification.
- Use the authenticated GitHub metadata API under repository administration rights for F20, then verify exact readback through the same principal.
- Change generated artifacts only through their canonical sources.
- Sequence children that share generated artifacts. Rebase and regenerate each later child from current `origin/main` before its gates.
- Land each repository child as an independently reviewable Gerrit change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] F08A documents current claim, relation, unlink, help, and close behavior.
- [x] F08B documents current installation dependencies and Git requirements.
- [x] F09 distinguishes asymmetric operation certificates from generic and legacy HMAC records.
- [x] F10 documents import batching, partial results, rerun behavior, and recovery limits.
- [x] F12 makes every visible top-level route discoverable through supported help forms.
- [x] F13 emits complete MCP summaries and correct transition semantics.
- [x] F19A removes the nonexistent MCP configuration-surface claim.
- [x] F19B generates a public description for every emitted typed configuration key.
- [x] F19C corrects current configuration history and diagnostic-switch guidance.
- [x] [operator-attested] F20 updates the GitHub About description.
  provenance: environment=github.com/navapbc/rebar; principal=repository-admin-token; privilege_posture=broader; instrument=live-call — child F20 used the authenticated GitHub metadata API and exact readback verification recorded on its ticket.
- [x] [operator-attested] F20 leaves repository files unchanged.
  provenance: environment=github.com/navapbc/rebar; principal=repository-admin-token; privilege_posture=broader; instrument=live-call — GitHub repository metadata update touched only description fields; child F20 readback verified files were not part of the metadata operation.
- [x] [operator-attested] F20 leaves topics unchanged.
  provenance: environment=github.com/navapbc/rebar; principal=repository-admin-token; privilege_posture=broader; instrument=live-call — child F20 exact readback verified topics were unchanged after the metadata update.
- [x] [operator-attested] F20 leaves the homepage unchanged.
  provenance: environment=github.com/navapbc/rebar; principal=repository-admin-token; privilege_posture=broader; instrument=live-call — child F20 exact readback verified the homepage field was unchanged.
- [x] Every repository child passes its applicable local checks.
- [x] [operator-attested] Every repository child receives LLM-Review +1 before merge.
  provenance: environment=gerrit-rebar-main; principal=gerrit-review-bot; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — merged Gerrit changes for the repository children carried the required LLM-Review +1 vote before submit.
- [x] [operator-attested] Every repository child receives Verified +1 before merge.
  provenance: environment=gerrit-rebar-main; principal=gerrit-ci; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — merged Gerrit changes for the repository children carried the required Verified +1 vote before submit.
- [x] [operator-attested] The GitHub metadata child passes plan review before close.
  provenance: environment=rebar-ticket-store; principal=trusted-plan-review-gate; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — F20 was plan-reviewed and closed through the recorded gate trail.
- [x] [operator-attested] The GitHub metadata child receives exact readback verification before close.
  provenance: environment=github.com/navapbc/rebar; principal=repository-admin-token; privilege_posture=broader; instrument=live-call — F20 closure evidence recorded exact GitHub metadata readback.
- [x] [operator-attested] The repository batch is merged to `main`.
  provenance: environment=gerrit-rebar-main; principal=gerrit-submit; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — all repository children are closed with merged Gerrit changes reachable from origin/main.
- [x] [operator-attested] Every descendant closes without force.
  provenance: environment=rebar-ticket-store; principal=ticket-closure-gates; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — descendant tickets are closed through normal transitions; no force closure was used.
